precheck.description: ensure RLS policy "forecast_retention_lock_be6f8360" does not exist
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_policies" WHERE ("schemaname" = $1 AND "tablename" = $2 AND "policyname" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: CREATE POLICY "forecast_retention_lock_be6f8360" ON "public"."forecast_runs" AS PERMISSIVE FOR UPDATE TO PUBLIC USING (current_setting('vops.retention', true) = 'true' AND expires_at <= (clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) WITH CHECK (false)
